title: Part 3 : 2021: Petroleum and its products methods of sampling: Part 3 method of sampling of semi - Solid and solid petroleum products First Revision
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (Part 3) prescribes methods for obtaining representative samples of semi-solid and solid petroleum and its products for purpose of test or examination. WARNING — The use of this document can involve hazardous materials, operations and equipment. This Standard does not purport to address all of the safety problems associated with its use. It is the responsibility of users of this document to take appropriate measures to ensure the safety and health of personnel prior to the application of the standard, and to determine the applicability of regulatory limitations and any other restrictions for this purpose.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Methods of sampling of coal and coke, Part 2: Sampling of coke

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
